title: Intelligence Before Brains
description: Explore how intelligence emerged in evolution - from bacterial chemotaxis to the first nervous systems. Understanding biological intelligence illuminates what we're trying to build artificially.
targetAudience: Those interested in the evolutionary origins of cognition
keyTakeaways: Intelligence predates neurons by billions of years
Bacteria use temporal comparison for navigation
C. elegans demonstrates sophisticated behavior with 302 neurons
Understanding evolution helps design better AI architectures
